window.main.titleWithApp.description: Area: window. A window title: the product name “Waypoint” (not translated), an em dash, then the window’s name.

window.main.description.message: The tabbed file browser — coming soon.

window.main.startFailed.message: Waypoint could not start the file browser.

window.shelf.dropHint.message: Drop to add to the Shelf

window.shelf.startFailed.message: Waypoint could not start the Shelf window.

services.intro.message: What works on this system, and why not when something does not. Waypoint hides options that cannot work here.

services.features.description: Area: services. Placeholders, kept exactly as written: {features} is a list of what works.

services.name.native-dnd.message: Drag and drop with other apps

settings.integrations.rememberPassphrase.message: Offers to keep a passphrase in the system keyring when you unlock an encrypted volume, and unlocks remembered volumes by themselves when they are plugged in. Off until you turn it on.

settings.integrations.unreadable.message: Waypoint could not check what this system can do.

settings.integrations.notifications.desc.message: Shows a notification when a job finishes or fails while no Waypoint window is in front or after it ran for more than 10 seconds, and whenever a job needs your answer. Clicking it brings Waypoint forward.

settings.integrations.notificationAction.message: Adds buttons to a job’s notification: Show in folder when it finishes, Show details when it fails, Undo after a move or a trash, and Replace, Skip and Keep both when a file already exists. Some desktops show the buttons only when the notification is expanded, and some show only the click, which brings Waypoint forward.

settings.integrations.progress.label.message: Show progress on the app icon

settings.integrations.progress.descripti.message: Shows how far the running jobs have got on Waypoint’s dock or taskbar icon.

settings.integrations.sleep.label.message: Keep the computer awake during jobs

settings.integrations.sleep.description.message: Stops the computer from going to sleep while a job is running, and lets it sleep again afterwards.

settings.integrations.fileManager.make.l.message: Make Waypoint the default file manager

settings.integrations.fileManager.make.d.message: Folders that other applications open will open in Waypoint.

settings.integrations.fileManager.settin.message: Choose Waypoint in your system settings
Windows lets only you change the default. Open Default apps, then choose Waypoint for folders.

settings.integrations.fileManager.state..message: Waypoint is the default file manager.

settings.integrations.fileManager.state..description: Area: settings. Placeholders, kept exactly as written: {name} is the name of a file, folder, tab or other item.

settings.integrations.fileManager.failed.message: Could not make Waypoint the default: {reason}
settings.integrations.fileManager.failed.description: Area: settings. Placeholders, kept exactly as written: {reason} is why something failed, in the system’s own words.

settings.integrations.fileManager.servic.message: Open folders other applications ask for
While this is on, “Show in folder” and similar requests from other applications open in Waypoint, each folder in a new tab.

settings.integrations.shortcut.enabled.l.message: Bring Waypoint forward with a shortcut

settings.integrations.shortcut.enabled.d.message: Works from any application: raises the window you used last, or opens a new one.

settings.integrations.shortcut.key.descr.message: One or more of Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Super, then one key, such as Ctrl+Alt+W.

settings.appearance.mode.description.message: Light, dark, or whatever the system uses.

settings.appearance.mode.light.description: Area: settings. The light colour mode, as opposed to dark; not “light” as in lightweight.

settings.appearance.source.description.message: Waypoint's own colours, or the system's colour scheme and accent.

settings.appearance.source.liminal.description: Area: settings. Waypoint’s own colour scheme, named after the app. “Waypoint” is the product name and is not translated.

settings.appearance.accent.description.message: The text on it always keeps enough contrast; a colour that is too light or too dark is adjusted.

settings.appearance.systemColours.descri.message: Draws surfaces, text and the selection in the colours of your desktop’s theme instead of Waypoint’s own. The accent still follows its own setting, text keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast and the focus ring 3:1, and the Waypoint look is one click away.

settings.appearance.systemColours.lifted.message: To keep things readable, Waypoint adjusted {parts} from your system’s colours.
settings.appearance.systemColours.lifted.description: Area: settings. Placeholders, kept exactly as written: {parts}. A sentence that continues with a list of parts of the window, such as “text and the selection”.

settings.appearance.systemColours.part.t.description: Area: settings. Part of a list of what was adjusted, after “adjusted”: the colour of the text.

settings.appearance.systemColours.part.s.description: Area: settings. Part of a list of what was adjusted, after “adjusted”: the background of selected items.

settings.appearance.systemColours.part.s.message: the warning, error and success colours
settings.appearance.systemColours.part.s.description: Area: settings. Part of a list of what was adjusted, after “adjusted”: the warning, error and success colours.

settings.appearance.systemColours.part.f.description: Area: settings. Part of a list of what was adjusted, after “adjusted”: the outline that shows keyboard focus.

settings.appearance.systemColours.highCo.message: High contrast is on, which already uses the system’s own colours, so this setting has no effect now.

settings.appearance.systemColours.otherV.message: The colour mode above is set to a look that your system’s colours are not, so Waypoint’s own colours are drawn. Set it to System to use them.

settings.appearance.density.description.message: How much room lists and the window take.

settings.appearance.iconStyle.descriptio.message: The weight of the Waypoint icon theme's icons. It does not apply to Portage.

settings.appearance.iconStyle.light.description: Area: settings. The thinnest weight of Waypoint’s own icons, lighter than Regular; not the light colour mode.

settings.appearance.iconTheme.descriptio.message: The set of file and folder icons the file views, the sidebar and the Shelf draw. The icons in toolbars and menus do not change.

settings.appearance.iconTheme.waypoint.description: Area: settings. The name of an icon set, the one made for Waypoint. “Waypoint” is the product name and stays as is.

settings.appearance.iconTheme.portage.description: Area: settings. The name of an icon set (a portage is a carry between waterways), kept as “Portage”.

settings.appearance.iconTheme.system.description: Area: settings. The name of an icon set: the icons the operating system itself shows for files and folders (in its own file manager). Not “system” as in the computer.

settings.appearance.iconTheme.systemUnav.message: The System icon theme is not available on this system: {reason}
settings.appearance.iconTheme.systemUnav.description: Area: settings. Placeholders, kept exactly as written: {reason} is why something failed, in the system’s own words. {reason} is a sentence from the operating system layer, in English, that says what is missing.

settings.appearance.iconTheme.systemUnav.message: The System icon theme is not available on this system.

settings.appearance.iconStyle.systemNote.message: Icon style applies to the Waypoint icon theme. The System theme draws the icons your system draws.

settings.appearance.folderColour.descrip.message: The colour of folders in the Portage icon theme. The shade follows light or dark mode.

settings.appearance.folderColour.waypoin.message: Folder colours apply to the Portage icon theme. The Waypoint theme draws folders in the accent colour.

settings.appearance.folderColour.systemN.message: Folder colours apply to the Portage icon theme. The System theme draws folders as your system does.

settings.appearance.folderColour.liminal.description: Area: settings. A folder colour named for the brand: Liminal HQ’s own amber.

settings.appearance.folderColour.gnome.description: Area: settings. A folder colour named for the GNOME desktop’s blue; “GNOME” is not translated.

settings.appearance.folderColour.cinnamo.description: Area: settings. A folder colour named for the Cinnamon desktop’s green; “Cinnamon” is not translated.

settings.appearance.folderColour.kde.description: Area: settings. A folder colour named for the KDE Plasma desktop’s blue; “KDE” is not translated.

settings.appearance.folderColour.windows.description: Area: settings. A folder colour named for Windows 11’s yellow; “Windows 11” is not translated.

settings.appearance.folderColour.rainbow.description: Area: settings. A folder drawn in every colour of the rainbow, as a gradient.

settings.language.language.description.message: The language of menus, dialogs and messages, and how dates, numbers and sizes are written. Anything not translated yet appears in English.

settings.language.language.ar-XB.message: Mirrored, right to left (ar-XB, for developers)

settings.language.direction.description.message: Which way the window lays out. Automatic follows the language; the others are for checking a layout.

settings.access.highContrast.description.message: Black on white or white on black, with strong borders and an accent that is easy to see.

settings.access.textSize.description.message: Scales the text and the rows. The system text size counts too, whichever is larger.

settings.access.strongFocus.description.message: A thicker outline around whatever has keyboard focus.

settings.access.reducedMotion.descriptio.message: No sliding, springing or fading; changes happen at once.

settings.access.reducedTransparency.desc.message: Draws every surface solid, whatever the Transparency page says.

settings.access.touchMode.description.message: Larger targets, at least 44 px. Automatic turns it on after you touch the window, or when there is no mouse.

settings.general.startup.description.message: Bring back the windows and tabs from last time, or open one window at Home. Takes effect the next time Waypoint starts.

settings.general.defaultView.description.message: How a new window shows a folder. Windows that are already open keep their view.

settings.general.clickMode.description.message: Open files and folders with a single click or a double click.

settings.general.rememberFolderViews.des.message: A folder keeps the view, sort, grouping, hidden-files choice and icon size you last chose in it. Waypoint remembers up to 1,000 folders and forgets the one changed longest ago past that. Off, every folder shows the window’s view; what folders remembered is kept for when this is on again.

settings.general.appNameInTitle.label.message: Show the app name in the title bar

settings.general.appNameInTitle.descript.message: Starts the title bar’s label with “Waypoint”. Off, the label is just “Main”.

settings.general.menuBar.label.message: Show a menu bar under the title bar

settings.general.menuBar.description.message: Lays the application menu’s menus (File, Edit, View and Window) across a bar of their own. The app name button then stays as a label.

settings.general.showHidden.description.message: A new window lists hidden files. Windows that are already open keep their choice.

settings.general.confirmTrash.label.message: Confirm before moving to the Trash

settings.general.confirmTrash.descriptio.message: Moving to the Trash can be undone, so it does not ask unless you turn this on. Delete Permanently always asks.

settings.operations.verify.description.message: Reads each copied file back and compares it with the original. Slower, and worth it for removable drives.

settings.operations.algorithm.needsVerif.message: Turn on “Verify copies after writing” to choose one.

settings.operations.concurrency.descript.message: How many copies, moves and deletes run together; the rest wait in the queue. A change applies to the next operation.

settings.operations.speedLimit.descripti.message: Keeps every copy and move together under the speed below, which helps on a network or while you work. A change reaches jobs that are already running.

settings.operations.speedLimitValue.desc.message: The most data that copies and moves transfer each second, all together. A job can also have a limit of its own in the Operations window.

settings.operations.speedLimitValue.need.message: Turn on “Limit copy and move speed” to set this.

settings.operations.undoDepth.descriptio.message: How many operations Undo can step back through.

settings.operations.trashExpiry.label.message: Empty old items from the Trash

settings.operations.trashExpiry.descript.message: Permanently deletes items that have been in the Trash longer than the number of days below. It runs when Waypoint starts, and is off by default.

settings.operations.trashDays.descriptio.message: Counted from the day an item was moved to the Trash.

settings.operations.trashDays.needsExpir.message: Turn on “Empty old items from the Trash” to set this.

settings.operations.archiveEntries.label.message: Most entries in an archive to extract without asking

settings.operations.archiveEntries.descr.message: Extracting an archive that holds more entries than this asks first.

settings.operations.archiveBytes.label.message: Most an archive may expand to without asking

settings.operations.archiveBytes.descrip.message: Extracting an archive whose contents add up to more than this asks first.

settings.operations.archiveRatio.label.message: Most times its size an archive may expand to

settings.operations.archiveRatio.descrip.message: An archive that expands to far more than its own size may be built to fill the disk, so extracting one asks first. This applies only above the size below.

settings.operations.archiveFloor.label.message: Check the expansion ratio only above

settings.operations.archiveFloor.descrip.message: Small archives that compress very well are fine; the ratio is checked only when an archive expands to at least this much.

settings.operations.archiveReset.descrip.message: Puts the four limits above back to 1 000 000 entries, 100 GiB, 1 000 times its size, checked above 1 GiB.

settings.dnd.unavailable.message: Dragging files out to other applications is unavailable: {reason}
settings.dnd.unavailable.description: Area: settings. Placeholders, kept exactly as written: {reason} is why something failed, in the system’s own words.

settings.dnd.unavailable.noReason.message: this system does not support it.

settings.dnd.rule.description.message: What dropping files does when no modifier key is held. Ctrl copies, Shift moves and Alt opens the action picker, whatever this says.

settings.dnd.rule.byVolume.message: Move on the same volume, copy otherwise

settings.dnd.spring.description.message: How long a drag hovers over a folder, tab or sidebar item before it opens, from 200 to 2000 milliseconds.

settings.dnd.shelf.description.message: The Shelf keeps its items when Waypoint quits and starts again.

settings.previews.unavailable.message: Thumbnails are unavailable on this system: {reason}
settings.previews.unavailable.description: Area: settings. Placeholders, kept exactly as written: {reason} is why something failed, in the system’s own words.

settings.previews.unavailable.noReason.message: the thumbnail service could not start.

settings.previews.show.description.message: Draws a picture of an image, video or document in the grid, in tall list rows and on the Shelf, in place of its file type icon. A file with no thumbnail keeps its icon. Only files on this computer get one.

settings.previews.max.label.message: Largest file to make a thumbnail of

settings.previews.max.description.message: A larger file keeps its icon, so a huge image does not slow a folder down. Thumbnails already made are shared with other file managers and shown whatever the size.

settings.previews.measureHome.descriptio.message: Overview measures your home folder to list its biggest folders and to fill in "Your files" on the volume that holds it. A measurement less than an hour old is reused. Turn this off to measure only when you choose Measure now.

settings.transparency.unavailable.message: Transparency is unavailable on this system: {reason}
settings.transparency.unavailable.description: Area: settings. Placeholders, kept exactly as written: {reason} is why something failed, in the system’s own words.

settings.transparency.unknown.message: Waypoint could not tell whether this system can show the desktop through a window, so windows stay solid.

settings.transparency.preview.caption.message: A sample window over a bright, busy wallpaper, drawn with the settings below.

settings.transparency.enable.description.message: Lets the desktop show through the window. It is off until you turn it on, and it is always off under high contrast or reduced transparency.

settings.transparency.enable.experimenta.message: On Linux this is experimental: how it looks depends on the compositor and on WebKitGTK, and it is the first thing to turn off if a window looks wrong.

settings.transparency.off.highContrast.message: Transparency is off while high contrast is on (Accessibility).

settings.transparency.off.reducedTranspa.message: Transparency is off while reduced transparency is on (Accessibility).

settings.transparency.off.unavailable.message: Transparency is on in the settings, but this window cannot be see-through.

settings.transparency.off.unfocused.message: This window is solid while it is not in front.

settings.transparency.opacity.label.message: Title bar and menu bar opacity

settings.transparency.opacity.descriptio.message: How solid the title bar and the menu bar are. Lower is more see-through.

settings.transparency.opacity.rows.descr.message: How solid the tabs, the toolbar and the status bar are.

settings.transparency.opacity.sidebar.de.message: How solid the sidebar, the Inspector and the Shelf are.

settings.transparency.opacity.content.de.message: How solid the list and the grid are.

settings.transparency.opacity.raised.message: To keep text readable on this theme, this part stays at least {percent}% opaque.
settings.transparency.opacity.raised.description: Area: settings. Placeholders, kept exactly as written: {percent} is a percentage, a number without the % sign.

settings.transparency.blur.description.message: Blurs what is behind the window where it shows through. Low is a soft material, High a stronger one (Windows); on Linux both blur the same.

settings.transparency.blur.unavailable.description: Area: settings. Placeholders, kept exactly as written: {reason} is why something failed, in the system’s own words.

settings.transparency.blur.unavailable.n.message: this system offers no way to blur behind a window.

settings.transparency.reset.description.message: Puts every setting on this page back to its default, except the Transparent window switch.

settings.group.transparencyFocus.message: When the window is not in front

settings.transparency.regions.titleBar.d.message: The title bar, tabs, toolbar and status bar. Off keeps them on a solid background.

settings.transparency.regions.sidebar.de.message: The sidebar, the Inspector and the Shelf. Off keeps them on a solid background.

settings.transparency.regions.content.de.message: The list and the grid. Off keeps files on a solid background.

settings.transparency.menus.description.message: Context menus and the application menu show what is behind them, blurred.

settings.transparency.menuOpacity.descri.message: Menus stay close to solid so their text is easy to read.

settings.transparency.solidUnfocused.des.message: A window you are not using draws solid and gives up its blur, which also saves the compositor some work.

settings.open.failed.message: Could not open the Settings window.
